verdict.rationale: Kong exposes a documented RESTful Admin API for full configuration (kong-gh-5, kong-gh-10) plus a directory of OpenAPI specs (kong-docs-9) and the decK CLI for declarative/programmatic API lifecycle automation (kong-docs-4, kong-probe-4), giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product without a UI. Missing for 10: a single canonical machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger endpoint (probe found guessed paths 404, kong-probe-2) and independent hands-on confirmation of agents actually driving Kong via this API.
